items.title: Donovan Clingan, the Thompson Twins, and the Value of Shot Quality (xPTS RAPM)
items.author: Beneficial_Carry_530
items.body_excerpt: Good Afternoon y'all! NBA Season one month away. Wrote about creating xPTS-RAPM about two months ago and how it gave great insight into Kevin Durant and the value of tough shotmaking. This post is another excerpt from the paper and will focus on case studies of other players,…
